verdict.rationale: Customer.io's first-party docs describe several natural-language surfaces. An official MCP server lets users read workspace data, create and manage automations and sends, and work with segments "all through natural language prompts". There is also an in-app agent that builds segments from plain-text descriptions, analyzes the workspace, runs scheduled tasks, and takes requests in Slack, plus CLI skills that teach AI assistants to drive the product. Read, write and delete permissions can be approved separately. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language operation.
